config.js
DEFAULTS: 1280x720, 30fps, jpegQuality 0.65,
maxFrameBytes 524288, wsBufferThreshold 524288
relayOrigin ← ?relay= | __VIDPG_RELAY_ORIGIN__ | page origin
buildRelayWebSocketUrl → /ws?session=&side=

requestCamera / attachPreview / stopCamera
CameraError states: insecure-context, unsupported-browser,
permission-denied, no-camera, camera-ended

sampleAndEncode → {payload, bytes, w, h,
capturedWallUs, capturedMonotonicNs, encodeDurationMs}
busy guard: max 1 encode

uploader.js
startCaptureLoop (rVFC \u2192 setTimeout fallback)
skip reasons: RATE_GATE ENCODE_BUSY OVERSIZE_PAYLOAD
SOCKET_NOT_OPEN BUFFERED_AMOUNT_HIGH
ENCODE_ERROR SEND_ERROR
nextSequence() BigInt, sessionStorage persistence

RelaySocket: open Promise, onFrame/onControl/onError
sendJoin → await ready, sendFrame,
isSocketBackpressured(bufferedAmount > 524288)
no auto-reconnect

paintIfNewest (pendingRender + seq gate)
double buffer: inactive img → decode() → rAF → commitPaint
reasons: STALE_REMOTE REMOTE_* REMOTE_DECODE_ERROR
